tools.name: com-example-operation-read-name
tools.description: Reads the name of an organization.

org.description: An object reference (see "Object reference" in Definitions).

content.content:
## Definitions

<definition name="Object reference">
A parameter described as an object reference takes the object's URI exactly as it appears in Context Objects
or in a tool result, e.g. echo://<spaceId>/<objectId>.
Also accepted: <spaceId>:<objectId>; a bare <objectId> for an object in the current space; and
dxn:<typename>:<version> for a type that exists in the registry. A leading @ is ignored.
</definition>
What is the name of the organization? 01JGFJJZ00G0WKQSJGMAKCNT8D

content.text: I have an object ID from the user, so the next step is to call the tool with just that bare ID.
